apps.localizedDescription: Open Screen Sharing，开源 Apple VNC（macOS 屏幕共享）客户端与服务器。针对局域网与公网（Tailscale P2P）优化，并支持 RDP。侧载 IPA 含 App Store 版未提供的 iOS 端 Apple VNC 服务器与从远程 Mac 拖文件。

versions.localizedDescription:
* Add native touch, microphone and keep-alive support for RDP
* Improve RDP performance
* Add cursor customization
* Press and hold to drag in trackpad mode
* Allow empty passwords for account logins
* Add automatic unlock support for iOS server
* Dim iOS server display during sessions
* Fixes and improvements
